description: Check speed, RPM, and shift drop from tire size, final drive, and gear ratio. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Use measured tire diameter when possible. Tire growth and converter/clutch slip can move real-world numbers.

speed.description: Vehicle speed (mph in imperial; km/h in metric)

tireDiameter.description: Tire diameter (in in imperial; mm in metric)

unitSystem.description: Units for all inputs and results, as specified on each field.

outputSchema.description: Public calculator result with explicit units, website-equivalent results, or actionable invalid_input message.

status.description: Result status such as ok, created, updated, sent, auth_required, or confirmation_required.

tool.description: TuneWorks MCP tool name that produced this result.
